name: Docker
subtitle: Containerization platform
creator: Solomon Hykes at dotCloud
maintainer: Docker, Inc. (engine is the open-source Moby project)
description: Packages an app and its dependencies into an image built from a Dockerfile, which runs identically anywhere as an isolated container. Docker Compose defines multi-container setups such as app plus database plus cache for local development.

concepts.explanation: The template versus the running instance.
FROM, RUN, COPY and CMD build an image.
Build in one stage, ship a slim final image.
Docker Hub, GHCR and others store images.

codeSamples.label: Dockerfile
codeSamples.code:
# Multi-stage build for a Node app
FROM node:24-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:24-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]

pros: Near-universal: 71% usage, up 17 points in the Stack Overflow 2025 survey
cons: Image bloat and security scanning burden
Docker Desktop licensing for larger companies
File-sharing quirks on macOS and Windows

pricing.summary: Personal: free. Pro: $9/mo billed annually. Team: $15/user/mo annually. Business: $24/user/mo. Companies over 250 employees or $10M revenue need a paid plan for Docker Desktop.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
